detail.longDescription: I’ve got a counterargument for programmers who might think it’s irrelevant that some good programmers like # DHH are also horrible # bigots and racists. There’s a tendency in the # programming community to assume, that because their goals are great, it doesn’t matter that their values are like that.. The Soviet Union thought like that too. If there’s anything about humans that sticks, it’s that the means always become the ends. And because they do, very quickly, the product never arrives either.
